content: He who learns must also teach; he who gets must also give.
author: African Proverbs
explanation: Life is a circulatory system: blood that ceases to circulate immediately turns gangrenous and kills the host. Whatever insight, wealth, or safety you have been blessed to receive is not your private vault; it was given to you as a trustee to pass forward.
practicalInsight: Pass forward a lesson or financial blessing to someone who is currently in the shoes you once wore years ago.
reflectionPrompt: Are you acting as a reservoir that only hoards water, or as a living river that refreshes the valley?
